name: Motor-Driven Cycle
description: A motorcycle, motor scooter, motorized bicycle or similar conveyance with a motor attached and an engine of 50 cc or less. An e-bike falls here on public roads, since Alaska's statutes have no e-bike category. Defined by Alaska Statutes §28.90.990(a)(22).

restrictions.rule: Not a bicycle under Alaska's traffic rules, which define a bicycle as propelled exclusively by human power
The rider has the rights and duties of a vehicle driver
The rider needs a driver's license; a 14- or 15-year-old may ride with an M2 permit, which takes parental consent, a written motorcycle knowledge test and a vision test
The rider sits astride the permanent seat, facing forward, with both hands on the handlebars
Carries a passenger only on a permanent seat designed for more than one person
Entitled to a full traffic lane, but may not pass in the same lane or ride between lanes of traffic
